The '''2021 Boonta Eve Jawa Brawl''' was the second annual Boonta Eve Jawa Brawl, from 15 June to 31 July 2021. The theme was an R2-D2 alternate image. A sealed Enhanced Premiere pack went to the player with the most points, with strength of schedule as the tiebreak. A sealed Enhanced Jabba's Palace pack went to a random player who completed 12 games.<ref name="jawa21">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=78219 Prizes for the 2nd Annual Boonta Eve Jawa Brawl], forum.starwarsccg.org (25 May – 20 June 2021).</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Dates:''' 15 June – 31 July 2021<ref name="jawa21" />
* '''Prizes in the photograph:''' a sealed Enhanced Jabba's Palace pack (Master Luke) and a sealed Enhanced Premiere pack (Obi-Wan Kenobi)<ref name="jawa21" />
* '''Other posted prizes:''' an R2-D2 alternate-image foil for a player who completed 12 games<ref name="jawa21" />
* A Reflections IV unlimited booster for each of the first 50 registered players who then played 12 games<ref name="jawa21" />
